description: Implementation of NativeWindow11 using Windows.UI.Composition APIs for Direct3D 11 on Windows, including COM interop and window management.

classes.name: CompositorNativeWindow11
classes.description: A class managing a native window with Windows.UI.Composition APIs, supporting swap chain creation and window properties.

classes.name: RoHelper
classes.description: A helper class for Windows Runtime (WinRT) API interop, managing dynamic loading of functions and API availability checks.

methods.name: CompositorNativeWindow11::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window; currently a stub returning true.

methods.name: CompositorNativeWindow11::getClientRect
methods.description: Retrieves the client rectangle of the window based on visual size and offset.

methods.name: CompositorNativeWindow11::isIconic
methods.description: Indicates whether the window is minimized; always returns false.

methods.name: CompositorNativeWindow11::createSwapChain
methods.description: Creates a Direct3D swap chain linked to the composition surface.

methods.name: CompositorNativeWindow11::commitChange
methods.description: Commits changes; no action needed due to implicit commit model.

methods.name: CompositorNativeWindow11::IsValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Checks if the window is a supported sprite visual.

methods.name: CompositorNativeWindow11::IsSupportedWinRelease
methods.description: Checks if the Windows release supports required features.

methods.name: CompositorNativeWindow11::IsSpriteVisual
methods.description: Determines if a window handle corresponds to a SpriteVisual.

methods.name: RoHelper::RoHelper
methods.description: Constructor that loads WinRT DLLs and functions, checks API support.

methods.name: RoHelper::~RoHelper
methods.description: Destructor that releases loaded libraries and uninitializes WinRT.

methods.name: RoHelper::WinRtAvailable
methods.description: Returns whether WinRT APIs are available.

methods.name: RoHelper::SupportedWindowsRelease
methods.description: Checks if the Windows version supports required WinRT features.

methods.name: RoHelper::GetStringReference
methods.description: Creates a WinRT string reference from a source string.

methods.name: RoHelper::GetActivationFactory
methods.description: Retrieves a WinRT activation factory for a given class.

methods.name: RoHelper::CreateDispatcherQueueController
methods.description: Creates a WinRT dispatcher queue controller.
